payload.reason: The evidence provides specific improvement margins for the Zero-Shot Adaptive Transfer (ZAT) model compared to other models, indicating the extent of performance enhancement in terms of F1-score.

claims.text: The ZAT model shows an improvement of 7.24% in absolute F1-score when trained with 2000 instances.
ZAT achieves an improvement of 14.57% in absolute F1-score when trained with only 500 instances.
ZAT has a statistically significant mean improvement of 5.37 points over LSTM-BoE with 1000 training instances.
ZAT shows an improvement of 14.67 in absolute F1-score over CRF when training with 500 instances.
